screens.create-goal:
Use case: ui-mockup. Create a realistic, production-quality MOBILE APP UI MOCKUP for the existing Sobrita Android budget app in Spanish (Mexico). This is an actual proposed in-app screen, NOT a marketing poster or illustration. Show ONLY one app viewport edge-to-edge, logical size 390 x 844, natural portrait ratio 390:844, rendered sharply at high resolution. No phone bezel/body/notch/status bar/OS time/signal/battery/home indicator/browser chrome/outer mockup canvas. Do not put multiple screens in one image.
Grounding: attached Sobrita screenshots are actual existing design proposal captures and must anchor the visual language. Copy their cream paper surfaces (#FFFDF7 and #F6EFE0), navy #202848 pixel-like text and 2px angular borders, teal #0E7A72 controls, segmented progress, restrained offset shadows. Use PixelifySans-like readable pixel typography. Do not introduce generic rounded fintech cards, glossy gradients, giant advertising headlines, modern blue SaaS styling, or decorative interface clutter. Readable product typography: body 14–16 logical px, labels12–13, screen title20–22, key money24–28. App spacing16–20px, controls minimum44px. Typography, accent colors and framing must look at home in the supplied actual app. Two font families at most.
The goal feature is optional and has ONE active product goal. User adds their OWN product photo, name, target price, and money already set aside. No product shopping/search/affiliate checkout/automatic price tracking/automatic bank connection. No false automatic savings. Product photo is a simple realistic pair of unbranded off-white sneakers with muted teal panels and beige soles, on a neutral warm-gray surface. It must be a real photographic-style product image, NOT a pixel shoe icon, no logos. Match this exact product description across screens. Product name "Mis tenis", target "MX$1,500", initial amount already set aside "MX$600" =40%; any new contribution is MX$150, resulting amount MX$750=50%, remaining MX$750. A savings allocation is a record, not a transfer or new income.
Michi identity from attached sprite reference: one navy kitten with amber eyes, cream forehead stripes/muzzle/chest/paws/tail tip, teal collar and gold square buckle; draw only one cat if requested, never the sprite strip. Keep it small and native to the UI, not a huge ad mascot.
Use intentional visual hierarchy and only the essential controls. No invented rewards or fake app notifications. No Korean or English in the UI. Preserve Spanish accents. Current local date anchor 6 November 2026, America/Mexico_City; avoid dates on screen unless requested. All amounts are mock data.
Direction name: Foto que se vuelve meta. Focus: create a personal desired-product saving goal.
Design a focused full-screen goal creation page, not a bottom sheet so the form stays spacious. Top app bar left back-arrow, title "Crear mi meta". Beneath title smaller supportive line "Eso que quieres, más cerca."
Then a wide photo preview region roughly width350 x height190 logical px showing the white/teal sneakers clearly, with a quiet small camera action at bottom right "Cambiar foto". Below this, simple vertically spaced full-width labeled input fields, square outlines from source. Field1 label "¿Qué quieres comprar?" and filled value "Mis tenis". Field2 label "Precio objetivo" and filled value "MX$1,500". Field3 label "Ya tengo apartado" and filled value "MX$600". Helper under field3 "Dinero que ya separaste para esta compra." One understated optional add-link below fields "+ Añadir fecha objetivo (opcional)".
Near lower area show a simple progress preview on the page surface: "Empiezas con el 40%" and a10-segment bar with4 filled teal segments. Do not nest another card. Fixed prominent bottom full-width square teal button "Crear meta". Tiny footer above or below button if space allows "Puedes editar tu meta después." No bottom navigation on this form, no keyboard shown, no cat necessary, no extra fields or sections. Maintain natural margin at bottom. All visible content fully fits844 logical px.

Direction name: Tu meta a la vista. Focus: integrate desired product prominently in Sobrita Inicio without losing daily budgeting.
Design the home screen. Header "Sobrita" at left and settings gear at right. Top budget block uses existing source structure: label "Hoy te queda", large teal "MX$250", smaller "Para tus gastos de hoy". A thin divider below.
Main hero goal section begins "Mi meta" on left and small "Editar" on right. Use one bordered cream card with a large photographic sneaker photo region approximately320x160 logical px at top. Beneath photo inside SAME card: "Mis tenis"; prominent "MX$600 de MX$1,500" with40% aligned right; ten-segment progress bar exactly4 teal-filled cells and6 empty; supporting text "Te faltan MX$900". One small outlined/full-width action "Ver mi meta" with chevron. Product photo should visibly lead goal section, no nested cards.
Below the goal card show compact "Mi casa" section about120 logical px high based on supplied actual home room image: warm wood floor, a little window, the small Michi sitting on a rug, a glass savings jar on low side table. Small speech bubble "¡Tu meta va creciendo!" Keep the room visually secondary and compact; enough whitespace.
Bottom persistent navigation exactly five items from existing app: home icon "Inicio" selected teal; list "Movim."; raised square teal plus button in center; chart "Presup."; gear "Ajustes". Keep navigation at bottom of844 viewport, all main content visible, don't squeeze. Omit missions, XP, transaction lists, extra cards. This is a proposed focused home composition; source style stays unchanged.

Direction name: Lo que sobra tiene destino. Focus: intentional allocation of money to desired-product goal.
Design a standalone full-screen action page inspired by the source creation sheet, now with back-arrow and title "Apartar para mi meta". Under it a concise source row "Disponible del cierre" and value "MX$300", referring to already-recorded positive cycle remainder, NOT newly-earned income.
Next display a compact horizontal goal summary on the plain page surface: square sneaker photo100x100logical px on left, right text "Mis tenis" and "MX$600 de MX$1,500". Subtle divider.
Large input area label "¿Cuánto quieres apartar?" and square bordered active amount field "MX$150". Three quiet quick-amount controls on one row "MX$50", "MX$150", "Todo", with150 selected teal.
Then a clear progress preview section on page, not nested cards: label "Así quedaría tu meta"; comparison "40% → 50%" with50% in teal;10-segment bar5filled and5empty; exact text "MX$750 de MX$1,500" and "Te faltarían MX$750".
Small Michi sits beside glass jar with a small speech bubble "¡Un paso más cerca!" below progress, not oversized.
At bottom explanatory copy in readable small type "Solo lo registramos. Tu dinero no se mueve." Prominent full-width teal square button "Apartar MX$150". Secondary text action "Ahora no".
No bottom nav, no keyboard, no repeated submit buttons, no oversaving, no purchase button, no success already completed: this is pre-confirmation preview. Everything fits844 logical px with generous spacing.
